predictions.prediction_text: The market will break out of the call spread range to the upside, elevating volatility and pushing call implied volatility higher.
predictions.expected_result: Spot price moves above the call spread range and call IV rises materially within 1-5 trading days.

predictions.prediction_text: If volatility realizes to the upside, it would cause a blow-off-top style spot spike.
predictions.expected_result: A rapid, large upward spike in spot price occurring within a short time window (hours to a few days) after an increase in realized volatility.

predictions.prediction_text: There is no demand support for bonds.
predictions.expected_result: Bond prices will fail to find buying interest and either stagnate or decline over the next few sessions.

predictions.prediction_text: If GDP is stronger, the market will interpret that as the Fed needing to act on inflation again, leading to a higher-for-longer rate outlook.
predictions.expected_result: Markets price in a higher-for-longer interest rate path (e.g., yields rise and rate-sensitive assets decline) following release of stronger GDP data.
